verdict.rationale: Statsig documents scheduled gradual rollouts of Feature Gates and a manual emergency disable switch. Its Infra Analytics lets you set alerts to catch regressions. Nothing in the evidence ties those alerts or metric results to a gate, so a detected regression does not automatically halt or roll back the release. Missing for 10: automatic rollback triggered by metric regressions, rollout guardrail metrics bound to gates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
